H4601O.name: Maacah
H4601O.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4601O.brief: Father of Hanan, one of David's mighty men
H4601O.short: Maacah was the father of Hanan, one of David's mighty men.

H4601L.name: Maacah
H4601L.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4601L.brief: Caleb's concubine; mother of Sheber and Tirhanah
H4601L.short: Maacah, Caleb's concubine, was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.

H4601P.name: Maacah
H4601P.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4601P.brief: Father of Shephatiah, leader of the Simeonites under David
H4601P.short: Maacah was the father of Shephatiah, the leader of the Simeonites during the reign of King David.

H4601M.name: Maacah
H4601M.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4601M.brief: Sister of Huppim and Shuppim; mother of Peresh and Sheresh
H4601M.short: Maacah, the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, was the wife of Machir and mother of Peresh and Sheresh.

H4601N.name: Maacah
H4601N.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H4601N.short: Maacah, the mother of Kish, the father of Saul.

H4601K.name: Maacah
H4601K.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H4601K.brief: Daughter of Abishalom; wife of Rehoboam; mother of Abijah
H4601K.short: Maacah, also known as Micaiah, the daughter of Abishalom (Absalom), was the wife of Rehoboam and mother of Abijah, king of Judah.

H4601I.name: Maacah
H4601I.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H4601I.brief: Daughter of Talmai; wife of David; mother of Absalom
H4601I.short: Maacah, the daughter of King Talmai of Geshur, was one of David's wives and the mother of Absalom.

H4601G.name: Maacah
H4601G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4601G.short: Maacah, a concubine of Nahor, was the mother of Nahor's son Tebah.

H4640.name: Maasai
H4640.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H4640.brief: Priest during the time of David and Nehemiah
H4640.short: Maasai, also known as Amashsai, was a priest who served during the time of  Nehemiah.

H4641G.name: Maaseiah
H4641G.desc: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4641G.brief: Levite gatekeeper during the reign of David
H4641G.short: Maaseiah, a Levite gatekeeper, served during the reign of King David.

H4641H.name: Maaseiah
H4641H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4641H.short: Maaseiah, a priest, assisted in the coronation of King Joash during the reign of Athaliah.

H4641I.name: Maaseiah
H4641I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4641I.brief: Army officer during King Uzziah's reign
H4641I.short: Maaseiah, an army officer, served under King Uzziah of Judah.

H4641J.name: Maaseiah
H4641J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4641J.brief: Ahaz's son killed by Zichri, an Ephraimite warrior
H4641J.short: Maaseiah, a son of King Ahaz of Judah, was killed by Zichri, an Ephraimite warrior, during a war between Judah and Israel.

H4641K.name: Maaseiah
H4641K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4641K.brief: Servant of King Josiah involved in temple repairs
H4641K.short: Maaseiah, a servant of King Josiah, was involved in the repair and restoration of the temple.

H4641L.name: Maaseiah
H4641L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4641L.brief: Priest who married a foreign woman during Ezra's time
H4641L.short: Maaseiah, a priest, was among those who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

H4641M.name: Maaseiah
H4641M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4641M.brief: Israelite who married a foreign woman during Ezra's time
H4641M.short: Maaseiah, an Israelite, was among those who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

H4641N.name: Maaseiah
H4641N.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4641N.brief: Priest who married a foreign woman during Ezra's time
H4641N.short: Maaseiah, a priest, was among those who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

H4641O.name: Maaseiah
H4641O.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4641O.brief: Israelite who married a foreign woman during Ezra's time
H4641O.short: Maaseiah, an Israelite, was among those who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

H4641X.name: Maaseiah
H4641X.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4641X.brief: Priest during the reigns of Zedekiah and Jehoiakim
H4641X.short: Maaseiah, a priest, served during the reigns of Kings Zedekiah and Jehoiakim of Judah.

H4641Y.name: Maaseiah
H4641Y.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4641Y.brief: False prophet during the Babylonian exile
H4641Y.short: Maaseiah, along with Ahab, was a false prophet who prophesied lies to the exiles in Babylon.

H4641Z.name: Maaseiah
H4641Z.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4641Z.brief: Ancestor of Jaazaniah; associated with the Rechabites
H4641Z.short: Maaseiah was an ancestor of Jaazaniah, who was associated with the Rechabites during the reign of Jehoiakim.

H4641S.name: Maaseiah
H4641S.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4641S.brief: One who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time
H4641S.short: Maaseiah was among those who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

H4641T.name: Maaseiah
H4641T.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4641T.brief: Descendant of Shiloni; lived in Jerusalem after the exile
H4641T.short: Maaseiah, a descendant of Shiloni, lived in Jerusalem after the exile.

H4641U.name: Maaseiah
H4641U.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4641U.brief: Descendant of Benjamin; lived in Jerusalem after the exile
H4641U.short: Maaseiah, a descendant of Benjamin, lived in Jerusalem after the exile.

H4641V.name: Maaseiah
H4641V.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4641V.brief: Priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall
H4641V.short: Maaseiah, a priest, participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall during the time of Nehemiah.

H4641W.name: Maaseiah
H4641W.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4641W.brief: Priest during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall
H4641W.short: Maaseiah, a priest, was among those who sang during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

H4641P.name: Maaseiah
H4641P.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4641P.brief: Israelite who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall
H4641P.short: Maaseiah, an Israelite, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near his house during the time of Nehemiah.

H4641Q.name: Maaseiah
H4641Q.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4641Q.brief: Levite who assisted Ezra in reading the Law
H4641Q.short: Maaseiah, a Levite, was among those who assisted Ezra in reading the Law to the people.

H4641R.name: Maaseiah
H4641R.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4641R.brief: Levite who helped explain the Law to the people
H4641R.short: Maaseiah, a Levite, assisted in explaining the Law to the people during the time of Nehemiah.

H4619.name: Maaz
H4619.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4619.brief: Son of Ram, from the tribe of Judah
H4619.short: Maaz was a son of Ram, a descendant of Judah.

H4648H.name: Mephibosheth
H4648H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H4648H.brief: Son of Saul and Rizpah, given to the Gibeonites.
H4648H.short: Mephibosheth, son of Saul and Rizpah, was given to the Gibeonites for execution.

H4648G.name: Mephibosheth
H4648G.desc: Jonathan's son living at the time of United Monarchy
H4648G.brief: Son of Jonathan and grandson of King Saul.
H4648G.short: Mephibosheth, also called Merib-baal, was the son of Jonathan and grandson of King Saul.

H4677.name: Mezobaites
H4677.brief: The people group of Jaasiel, one of David's warriors.
H4677.short: The Mezobaites were the people group of Jaasiel, one of David's mighty warriors.

H4649.name: Muppim
H4649.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4649.short: Muppim, also known as Shephupham, Shephuphan, or Shuphamite, was a son of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis, Numbers, and 1 Chronicles.

H4610.name: Akrabbim
H4610.brief: A pass marking the southern border of Judah
H4610.short: Akrabbim, a pass located in the Negev, marked the southern border of the tribe of Judah.

H4601R.name: Maacah
H4601R.short: Maacah (Maacath), a region near Geshur (<ref="Deu.3.14; Joshua 12:5">Deu.3.14; Joshua 12:5</ref>).

H4638.name: Maarath
H4638.brief: A town in the hill country of Judah
H4638.short: Maarath, a town in the hill country of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:59">Joshua 15:59</ref>).

H4629G.name: Maareh-geba
H4629G.brief: A place near Gibeah where an ambush was set
H4629G.short: Maareh-geba, a place near Gibeah where the Israelites set an ambush against the Benjamites (<ref="Judges 20:33">Judges 20:33</ref>).

H4632.name: Mearah
H4632.short: Mearah, a place near Sidon, mentioned in the description of the land yet to be conquered by the Israelites (<ref="Joshua 13:4">Joshua 13:4</ref>).

H4681.name: Mozah
H4681.brief: A town in the territory of Benjamin
H4681.short: Mozah was a town allotted to the tribe of Benjamin.

H4663.name: Muster Gate
H4663.brief: A gate in Jerusalem mentioned in Nehemiah's time
H4663.short: The Muster Gate, also known as the Miphkad Gate, was one of the gates of Jerusalem mentioned in Nehemiah's time.
